projectTitle: Launching a Fashion Brand Through Organic Social Media
summary: An organic Instagram launch system combining positioning, profile optimisation, premium product content and an enquiry-focused funnel.
challenge: The brand had no established digital presence and needed to introduce its premium Rida, jodi and women's-wear collection without paid promotion.
approach: Evolix created an elegant visual language, organised the profile, planned the launch and built a consistent pipeline of product-led organic posts and reels.
deliverables: Captions and enquiry calls to action
outcome: A consistent, recognisable Instagram presence capable of presenting products, attracting discovery and supporting enquiries organically.

testimonial.quote: Al Marjan had no real digital presence when we began working with Evolix. They helped us start our social-media journey with a clear marketing direction, consistent content and a proper lead funnel. It has been satisfying to see the brand take shape online and begin reaching the right people.
